d: A Data Center Operations Manager is responsible for the overall management, reliability, availability, compliance, and operational performance of the data center facility, including both critical infrastructure and day-to-day operations personnel.
Lead and manage all data center operations activities.
Ensure uninterrupted operation of critical infrastructure and customer services.
Develop and implement operational policies, procedures, and standards.
Manage 24/7 operations teams and shift personnel.
Electrical systems (MV/LV switchgear, UPS, batteries, PDUs)
Cooling systems (CRAH, CRAC, chillers, cooling towers)
Fire detection and suppression systems (VESDA, FM200, Novec 1230, sprinklers)
Physical security systems and access controls
Ensure compliance with contractual SLAs and KPIs.
Maintain target availability (e.g., Tier III/Tier IV requirements).
Manage facilities engineers, technicians, white space engineers, and contractors.
Conduct performance reviews and staff development programs.
Ensure adequate staffing and shift coverage.
Lead response to critical incidents and emergencies.
Approve and oversee Root Cause Analysis (RCA) reports.
Chair or participate in Change Advisory Board (CAB) meetings.
Ensure high change-success rates and minimal operational risk.
Health, Safety, Security, and Environmental (HSSE) requirements
Act as the primary operational interface with customers.
Manage OEM maintenance providers and subcontractors.
Review service reports and maintenance performance.
Participate in customer meetings and operational reviews.
Maintain risk registers and business continuity plans.
Manage energy efficiency and sustainability initiatives.
Produce monthly and quarterly operational reports.
The Data Center Operations Manager typically has end-to-end responsibility for:

In a hyperscale or colocation environment, this role is usually the senior operational owner of the facility and reports to the Head of Data Center Operations, Director of Operations, or Country Data Center Manager.
Our client is a leading global asset management firm with a strong international presence and an expanding institutional business across the Middle East.

The firm offers a comprehensive range of investment solutions spanning fixed income, equities, private markets, real estate, and alternative investments, serving institutional and professional investors globally.

As part of its continued growth in Saudi Arabia, our client is seeking a highly experienced Senior Relationship Manager at Director or Executive Director level to develop institutional relationships, expand distribution capabilities, and support the firm's long-term strategic growth in the Kingdom.
The successful candidate will be responsible for managing and expanding relationships with institutional investors across Saudi Arabia, with a primary focus on Riyadh.
The position requires an established network of institutional clients, strong investment product knowledge, and significant experience in institutional capital raising and investment distribution.
The successful individual will play a key role in strengthening the firm's institutional presence in Saudi Arabia while working closely with regional leadership and global investment teams.
q: Minimum 10–15+ years of experience in institutional relationship management, business development, or investment distribution.
Strong background within asset management, investment banking, financial institutions, private equity, or related investment businesses.
Established institutional investor network in Riyadh and the wider Saudi Arabian market.
Existing relationships with sovereign wealth funds, financial institutions, pension funds, insurance companies, endowments, and leading family offices.
Demonstrated experience in institutional capital raising, business origination, and strategic relationship development.
Strong understanding of institutional investment products and asset management distribution.
Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
Fluent English, both written and spoken.
Commercially driven, proactive, confident, and capable of operating independently.
Existing institutional relationships across other GCC markets.
Strong knowledge of fixed income and credit investment strategies .
Arabic language proficiency would be a significant advantage.
Join a leading global asset management firm with an established international investment platform.
Take a senior role in expanding institutional distribution across Saudi Arabia.
Develop strategic relationships with some of the region's most significant institutional investors.
Work closely with international investment teams and regional leadership.
Access a diversified range of investment solutions and institutional strategies.
Benefit from a comprehensive employment package, including healthcare coverage, annual leave, and additional employee benefits.
r: Lead business development and institutional distribution activities across Saudi Arabia, with a particular focus on Riyadh.
Identify and develop new relationships with institutional investors and strategic investment partners.
Originate capital raising opportunities across a broad range of investment strategies and asset classes.
Introduce the firm's investment capabilities to prospective institutional clients.
Support the expansion of the firm's institutional investor base in the Kingdom.

Leverage an established institutional investor network to originate new business.
Develop long-term relationships with key investment decision-makers.

Strengthen relationships with Tier I and Tier II family offices and ultra-high-net-worth investors.
Promote investment strategies across fixed income, credit, equities, alternatives, and other relevant asset classes.
Work closely with global investment specialists to present appropriate solutions to institutional investors.
Understand institutional investor requirements, investment mandates, and allocation priorities.
Coordinate investor engagement with relevant portfolio management and investment teams.
Support capital raising initiatives and investment strategy discussions.
Monitor investment trends, institutional capital allocation priorities, and market developments within Saudi Arabia.
Provide strategic insights and investor feedback to regional leadership.

d: The Software Alliances team at Canonical works with leading software companies to optimize and enable their products with Ubuntu and other Canonical software, for instance our AI offerings. We develop joint product roadmaps, drive delivery, and formulate go-to-market plans, content and processes, enabling differentiated offerings and robust product life-cycle support anchored to best-in-class Canonical products. Enterprises are able to receive the benefits of open source, securely maintained, and validated solutions from cloud to edge, whether purchased from Canonical, embedded in Alliance partners’ products, or accessed through the cloud.

The successful candidate is someone who has demonstrated success in business development or product management, both as a leader and an individual contributor in major accounts. If you are someone who is passionate about open source, can navigate complex new technical challenges, learn quickly, and architect solutions and strategies across global teams, this challenging role is for you. This role is ideal for professionals with 7+ years of experience.
Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region.
Setting the account strategy in a major account, region, and/or vertical.
Collaborating with product, engineering, alliance and marketing teams at partners to align on open-source strategies.
Capturing partner requirements, evaluating gaps, and identifying Canonical opportunities.
Coordinating with marketing and product teams on messaging, content creation, and launch plans.
Creating partner- and customer-facing materials like reference architectures, joint blueprints, webinars, presentations, videos, and white papers.

Driving Ubuntu adoption within targeted alliance accounts, advocating its benefits to stakeholders and working with partners on enablement training for their development, delivery, support and commercial teams.
Influencing alliance partners to build with Canonical technology.
Up to 25% travel, including internationally, for internal conferences and to drive partnerships in person.
What we are looking for in you
Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path.
Bachelor's degree in science, technology and/or engineering.
Experience in software development and system architecture.
Customer-facing experience in software engineering, product management, business development, technology strategy or similar functions.
Excellent communication skills across all levels of stakeholders - individual contributors to the C-suite; ability to grasp complex material and synthesize key points.
Ability to think and work at both strategic and tactical levels.
Disciplined and self motivated for a remote-first workplace environment.
q: Experience with open source software and open source business models.
Product management or program management experience.
Understanding of marketing and go-to-market strategy.
Sector-specific experience in finance, telecommunications, automotive, or public sectors.
Working knowledge of independent hardware and software vendor go-to-market motions.
Post-graduate degree in science, technology or engineering field.
